facts.text: Raw signal injection is a distinct test method whose value depends entirely on the insertion point.
facts.quote: raw injection as a method in its own right because its value depends entirely on the insertion point.

facts.text: In raw signal injection testing, the ECU or sensor-processing electronics downstream of the injection point are real hardware.
facts.quote: What is real is the ECU or sensor-processing electronics downstream of the injection point.

facts.text: Raw signal injection testing requires the exact electrical and protocol interface, a realistic raw stream, synchronisation and an interface adapter.
facts.quote: It needs the exact electrical and protocol interface, a realistic raw stream, synchronisation and an interface adapter.

facts.text: Raw signal injection testing proves the processing chain downstream of the injection point.
facts.quote: It proves the processing chain downstream of the injection

facts.text: Raw signal injection testing proves bandwidth and timing behaviour downstream of the injection point.
facts.quote: It proves the processing chain downstream of the injection, bandwidth and timing behaviour

facts.text: Raw signal injection testing proves handling of corrupted frames and interface faults downstream of the injection point.
facts.quote: It proves the processing chain downstream of the injection, bandwidth and timing behaviour, handling of corrupted frames and interface faults.

facts.text: Raw signal injection testing cannot prove components or effects upstream of the injection point, including the lens and imager, RF antenna and front end, lidar transmitter and receiver, or sensor contamination.
facts.quote: It cannot prove whatever lies upstream: lens and imager, RF antenna and front end, lidar transmitter and receiver, or sensor contamination.

facts.text: Camera raw-image injection is commercially implemented, according to vendor on-road evidence.
facts.quote: Camera raw-image injection is commercially implemented

facts.text: The limitations of camera raw-image injection depend on the insertion point.
